title: v4.5 RC1 - Godot XR Vendors Plugin crashes the engine
body:
### Tested versions

Engine version: Godot Engine v4.5 (6c9aa4c7d3b9b91cd50714c40eeb234874df7075) - RC1

### System information

Arch Linux - v4.5 RC1 - Compatability renderer

```
> gcc --version
gcc (GCC) 15.2.1 20250813
```

### Issue description

Adding https://github.com/GodotVR/godot_openxr_vendors to the project addons crashes the engine when reloading the project.

I manually recompiled the plugin using the master branch of godot-cpp https://github.com/godotengine/godot-cpp and still having the same issue.

Recompiling the engine with debug symbols give no additional information or relevant stack trace.

```
(gdb) OpenGL API 3.3.0 NVIDIA 580.82.07 - Compatibility - Using Device: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060


================================================================
handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 11
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.5.beta.custom_build (6c9aa4c7d3b9b91cd50714c40eeb234874df7075)
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug on: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues
[1] /usr/lib/libc.so.6(+0x44900) [0x7ffff7c44900] (??:0)
[2] typeinfo name for std::ios_base::failure (??:0)
-- END OF C++ BACKTRACE --
================================================================
bt full
No stack.
(gdb) Quit
```

### Steps to reproduce

Download the v4.1.1 Open XR Vendors Plugin, add to res://addons, re-open project

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

https://github.com/bearlikelion/xr_gamejam_2025
